解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
It used to be so straightforward.
第1段，第1句
"used to"表示过去常态或过去状态，是常见且可迁移的基础句式；主系表结构也非常典型。掌握这
种句型后，处理类似的过去状态表达会更稳。
Depending on the comments received, the editor would accept the paper for
publication or decline it.
第1段，第4句
句首用分词短语交代依据，后面接一个清晰主干，这种写法在考试阅读和写作中都很常见。掌握这
种“附加说明 + 主干 + 并列动作”的读法，迁移性较强。

The Internet – and pressure from funding agencies, who are questioning why
commercial publishers are making money from government-funded research by
restricting access to it – is making free access to scientific results a reality.
第2段，第2句
涵盖宾语补足语、双层嵌套从句、非限制性定语、方式状语等多种成分；主语被破折号插入成分扩
展为复杂结构，练习识别插入成分与主干的分离；宾语从句中包含介词短语状语和动名词短语状
语，成分丰富且层次分明。
The International Association of Scientific, Technical and Medical Publishers says
that there are more than 2,000 publishers worldwide specializing in these
subjects.
第3段，第4句
“某机构 says that ...” 和 “there are ...” 都是很常见的书面说明句式。掌握这种“主句引述 + 宾语从句
+ 存在句”的组合后，迁移到大量说明文句子都很有帮助。
They publish more than 1.2 million articles each year in some 16,000 journals.
第3段，第5句
这种“主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 时间状语 + 介词短语”的信息型陈述句非常常见，阅读材料和考试句子
里经常出现。掌握这种顺序化拆解方法，迁移性很强。
According to the OECD report, some 75% of scholarly journals are now online.
第4段，第2句
这种“句首依据来源状语 + 主系表陈述”的结构很常见，阅读材料里经常出现。掌握后可迁移到大量
带报告来源、数据来源的句子。
There is the so-called big deal, where institutional subscribers pay for access to a
collection of online journal titles through site-licensing agreements.
第4段，第4句
“先用主句引出概念，再用逗号后的关系从句补充解释”是阅读里很常见的写法。掌握这种识别顺序
后，处理同类说明性长句时可直接迁移。

Finally, there are open-access archives, where organizations such as universities or
international laboratories support institutional repositories.
第4段，第6句
“主句先给出核心名词，后面用关系词引出补充说明”是很常见的书面句式。"there are ... , where ..."
这种结构对阅读中快速抓主干很有代表性。
Other models exist that are hybrids of these three, such as delayed open-access,
where journals allow only subscribers to read a paper for the first six months,
before making it freely available to everyone who wishes to see it.
第4段，第7句
本句涵盖主谓、系表、主谓宾、宾语补足语等多种基本句型,包含限制性和非限制性定语从句、时
间状语、举例插入语等丰富成分,且关系代词 that、where、who 在各自从句中充当不同成分(主
语、状语性连接、主语),非常适合作为成分划分的综合训练材料,能帮助学生掌握多种常见结构的识
别方法。

paras.en: The trend in sports, though, may be obscuring an unrecognized reality: Americans have generally stopped growing. Though typically about two inches taller now than 140 years ago, today's people – especially those born to families who have lived in the U.S. for many generations – apparently reached their limit in the early 1960s. And they aren't likely to get any taller. "In the general population today, at this genetic, environmental level, we've pretty much gone as far as we can go," says anthropologist William Cameron Chumlea of Wright State University. paras.en: Growth, which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and nutrients – notably, protein – to feed expanding tissues. At the start of the 20th century, under-nutrition and childhood infections got in the way. But as diet and health improved, children and adolescents have, on average, increased in height by about an inch and a half every 20 years, a pattern known as the secular trend in height. Yet according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, average height – 5′9″ for men, 5′4″ for women – hasn't really changed since 1960.
paras.zh: 生长很少持续到20岁以后，需要卡路里和营养物质——尤其是蛋白质——来供给不断扩展的组织。在20 世纪初，营养不良和儿童期感染妨碍了生长。但随着饮食和健康状况的改善，儿童和青少年平均每20年身 高增加约一英寸半，这种模式被称为身高的长期趋势。然而，根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据，自 1960年以来，平均身高——男性5英尺9英寸，女性5英尺4英寸——实际上并没有真正改变。

questions.analysis:

哪个论点。
【拆句】Wilt Chamberlain is cited as an example to____ 是被动结构，主语 Wilt Chamberlain 是
被引用的对象，真正的施动者是文章作者；不定式 to____ 表目的，需要在选项里补一个动
词短语，回答"作者引用他来做什么"。结构平直无陷阱。
【定位】In the early 1960s Wilt Chamberlain was one of the only three players in the National
Basketball Association (NBA) listed at over seven feet. If he had played last season, however,
he would have been one of 42. The bodies playing major professional sports have changed
dramatically over the years.
上世纪60年代初，威尔特·张伯伦是 NBA 中仅有的三位身高超七英尺的球员之一。可若他在
上赛季打球，他会是 42 位这样的球员之一。多年来，从事重大职业体育的运动员的体型已
经发生了戏剧性变化。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
The bodies playing major professional sports have changed dramatically over the years ↔
illustrate the change of height of NBA players
预判"示范身高在变"与 illustrate the change of height of NBA players 一一对应，作
者举张伯伦正是为了让"3 人→42 人"的身高对比说话。
B)
无中生有
选项 show the popularity of NBA players in the U.S. 中 popularity 一词在 P1 乃至
全文都没有出现，作者也未谈 NBA 球员是否受欢迎，是凭印象添加。
C)
偷换概念
P1 只把张伯伦时代与上赛季两个时间点的球员数量做对比，并未拿出多代 NBA 球员逐
代相较；选项 compare different generations of NBA players 把"对比身高数据"偷换
成"代际比较"。
D)
答非所问
P1 通篇不评张伯伦或其他球员的篮球成就，仅用其身高数据做例子；选项 assess the
achievements of famous NBA players 答非所问。

options.A: Genetic modification.
options.B: Natural environment.
options.C: Living standards.
options.D: Daily exercise.

questions.analysis:
【判型】Which of the following plays a key role in body growth according to the text? 是
which 引导的事实判断，问"根据原文，哪一项起关键作用"，要求直接到文中找事实陈述，
属典型细节题。
【拆句】Which of the following plays a key role in body growth according to the text? 主干
Which plays a key role，which 作主语；介词短语 in body growth 限定范围，
according to the text 限定依据来源。无难点。
【定位】Growth, which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and nutrients –
notably, protein – to feed expanding tissues. At the start of the 20th century, under-nutrition
and childhood infections got in the way. But as diet and health improved, children and
adolescents have, on average, increased in height by about an inch and a half every 20 years,
a pattern known as the secular trend in height.
生长——通常不会延续到 20 岁以后——需要热量与营养（尤其是蛋白质）来供养扩张中的
组织。20 世纪初，营养不良与儿童期感染挡住了路。但随着饮食和健康的改善，儿童和青
少年的平均身高每 20 年增加约一英寸半，这一规律被称作"身高的世俗增长趋势"。
32. Which of the following plays a key role in body growth according to the text?
[ A ] Genetic modification.
[ B ] Natural environment.
[ C ] Living standards.
[ D ] Daily exercise.

【选项】A)
无中生有
P4 反而说基因 constraints 限制了进一步长高，从未把 Genetic modification（基因改
造）当成长高原因；Genetic modification 在文中既不存在也与文意相反。
B)
以偏概全
at this genetic, environmental level 仅一笔带过 environmental，并未把"自然环
境"立为身高增长的关键因素；真正被原文展开论证的是饮食/健康，而非自然环境。
C)
✓ 正确
as diet and health improved, children and adolescents have, on average, increased in height by
about an inch and a half every 20 years
↔Living standards.
calories and nutrients ↔Living standards.
把饮食、营养、健康打包升一级，得到"生活水平"，与 Living standards. 完全等值，故
选 C。
D)
无中生有
全文谈到生长的条件只有 calories and nutrients 与 diet and health，从未涉及 Daily
exercise，属常识硬塞。

options.A: Non-Americans add to the average height of the nation.

questions.analysis:
【判型】On which of the following statements would the author most probably agree? 用
most probably agree 询问作者最可能赞同的命题，没有给出明确定位词，要求四选项逐项
回原文比对，是推断题特征。
【拆句】On which of the following statements would the author most probably agree? 是
on which 前置的疑问句，正常语序应为 The author would most probably agree on
which of the following statements——介词 on 与 agree 搭配，对薄弱考生可能造成结
构错觉。
【定位】Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet and back
continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain imposed
by oversize limbs.
而且，尽管人类已经直立行走了数百万年，我们的脚和背依然在与双足姿势苦战，难以承受
来自过长肢体反复施加的劳损。
33. On which of the following statements would the author most probably agree?
[ A ] Non-Americans add to the average height of the nation.
[ B ] Human height is conditioned by the upright posture.
[ C ] Americans are the tallest on average in the world.
[ D ] Larger babies tend to become taller in adulthood.

【选项】A)
张冠李戴
In the case of NBA players, their increase in height appears to result from the
increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world. 只解
释 NBA 球员变高的特殊原因，并未涉及"非美籍人士拉高了全美平均身高"——文中明确
强调 Americans have generally stopped growing。
B)
✓ 正确
our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated
strain imposed by oversize limbs
↔Human height is conditioned by the upright posture.
脚与背承受不住超长肢体的劳损，就意味着"长得太高"会与直立姿势冲突，故"身高受直
立姿势制约"正是作者立场。
C)
无中生有
原文只给美国数据 5′9″ for men, 5′4″ for women 和增长趋势，未与任何其他国家比
较；tallest on average in the world 完全无据。
D)
过度推断
During childbirth, larger babies have more difficulty passing through the birth
canal. 把 larger babies 与生育困难联系，并未给出"大宝宝长大会更高"的因果；选项与
原文反向偷推。

息直接源自原文段，要求复述段中事实，不需多步推理，是细节题。
【拆句】We learn from the last paragraph that in the near future____ that 引导宾语从句，从句

[ A ] the garment industry will reconsider the uniform size.
[ B ] the design of military uniforms will remain unchanged.
[ C ] genetic testing will be employed in selecting sportsmen.
[ D ] the existing data of human height will still be applicable.

【定位】She says that, unlike those for basketball, the length of military uniforms has not changed
for some time. And if you need to predict human height in the near future to design a
piece of equipment, Gordon says that by and large, "you could use today's data and feel
fairly confident."
她说，和篮球队服不同，军服的长度已经很久没改过了。如果你需要在不久的将来预测人体
身高来设计某种装备，Gordon 说，总的来说，"你完全可以用今天的数据，并对此相当有
信心"。
【选项】A)
无中生有
P5 仅讲 Gordon 所在的陆军研究中心和"军服长度未变"，根本没提服装产业是否会重审
尺码；the garment industry will reconsider 无中生有。
B)

的事实，并未承诺未来必然不变；will remain unchanged 把过去事实当成未来保证。
C)
无中生有
P5 谈装备设计与身高预测，与基因检测选拔运动员无关；genetic testing 在末段没有
任何对应。
D)
✓ 正确
you could use today's data and feel fairly confident ↔
the existing data of human height will still be applicable

转述。

[ A ] the change of human height follows a cyclic pattern.
[ B ] human height is becoming even more predictable.
[ C ] Americans have reached their genetic growth limit.
[ D ] the genetic pattern of Americans has altered.

【选项】A)
无中生有

B)

Genetic maximums can change, but don't expect this to happen soon. ↔
Americans have reached their genetic growth limit.

约数。
D)
与原文相反

If he had played last season, however, he would have been one of 42.
第1段，第2句
与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句是四六级和考研的高频考点,该句 "If + 过去完成时,主语 + would
have done" 的结构是教材中的标准范式。掌握这一句式后可直接迁移到大量同类真题,代表性
极强。

Though typically about two inches taller now than 140 years ago, today's people –
especially those born to families who have lived in the U.S. for many generations –
apparently reached their limit in the early 1960s.
第2段，第2句
成分丰富且涵盖多个易错点：句首让步状语短语（含比较结构和省略）、破折号同位语插入、嵌套
定语从句、多个状语（时间、地点、方式）的识别。特别是插入语和定语从句的归属判断，以及谓
语在干扰成分中的定位，都是很好的划分练习点。
"In the general population today, at this genetic, environmental level, we've pretty
much gone as far as we can go," says anthropologist William Cameron Chumlea of
Wright State University.
第2段，第4句
本句的引述结构（引号 + says 引述动词）和状语从句修饰主句谓语的用法，都是四六级和考研真
题中的常见句式。现在完成时表达 "已经达到某个状态" 的用法也很典型。倒装结构虽然不是最常
见的，但在引述句中经常出现。掌握本句的分析方法后，可以迁移到大量类似的引述句和状语从句
句式中。
In the case of NBA players, their increase in height appears to result from the
increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.
第2段，第5句
本句的"主语 + appears to + 动词"结构以及"result from + 名词短语（内含后置定语）"的搭配，是
四六级和考研阅读中常见的表达因果关系的句式；句首状语和句末长状语的配置也符合真题常见模
式，具有较好的代表性和可迁移性。
Growth, which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and
nutrients – notably, protein – to feed expanding tissues.
第3段，第1句
主句+非限制性定语从句的组合在四六级和考研阅读中高频出现,插入语和不定式作目的状语也是典
型结构,学习者掌握本句的分析方法后可直接迁移到大量真题句式中。

During childbirth, larger babies have more difficulty passing through the birth
canal.
第4段，第2句
简单句 + 动名词短语作后置定语是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式，具有一定典型性。但本句缺
乏从句、复杂修饰或特殊结构，代表性略显不足，掌握后可在部分场景复用。
Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet
and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand
repeated strain imposed by oversize limbs.
第4段，第3句
让步状语从句前置 + 主句陈述转折结果，是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式；现在完成时与一般
现在时的时态对比、并列谓语的使用、后置定语的修饰，都是真题常考结构，学习后可迁移性强

individual organism," says anthropologist William Leonard of Northwestern
University.
第4段，第4句
直接引语 + 定语从句修饰主句宾语从句中的名词，是学术文章引用观点的典型句式；there be 句
型和限制性定语从句都是高频结构，代表性强

第32题题干
涉及疑问句中的主谓宾结构、两个状语（地点状语和方式状语），成分种类有一定覆盖，但结构过
于简单，缺少定语、复杂修饰或易混淆的成分，训练收益有限。
Larger babies tend to become taller in adulthood.
第33题，D
主系表结构配时间状语是常见句式，但"tend to"这种表趋势的动词搭配在考试中出现频率中等，不

39. Which of the following is true according to the text?
[ A ] Some Founding Fathers benefit politically from slavery.
[ B ] Slaves in the old days did not have the right to vote.
[ C ] Slaves owners usually had large savings accounts.
[ D ] Slavery was regarded as a peculiar institution.

【判型】Which of the following is true according to the text? 判断哪一项符合原文事实，本质是
细节核对。
【拆句】Q39 主干 "Which is true according to the text"，无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙。
【定位】And the statesmen's political lives depended on slavery. The three-fifths formula handed
Jefferson his narrow victory in the presidential election of 1800 by inflating the votes of the
southern states in the Electoral College.
国父们的政治生命依赖于奴隶制。三分之五公式通过虚增南方各州在选举人团中的票数，让
杰斐逊在 1800 年的总统选举中险胜。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
The three-fifths formula handed Jefferson his narrow victory in the presidential election of 1800
by inflating the votes of the southern states in the Electoral College
↔Some Founding Fathers benefit politically from slavery
原文已明示"奴隶制 → 杰斐逊胜选"，杰斐逊为国父之一，故"某些国父在政治上从奴隶
制获益"为真，锁定 A。
B)
无中生有
选项 Slaves in the old days did not have the right to vote 看似常识为真，但原文从
未讨论奴隶投票权——counted a slave as three fifths of a man for purposes of
congressional representation 谈的是奴隶在国会代表权计算中被算作五分之三，是"代
表权计算单位"，不是"投票权"，二者不可混。
C)
偷换概念
选项 Slaves owners usually had large savings accounts 把原文比喻 like having a
large bank account 当成字面事实理解；原文的本意是"奴隶就像一笔大额存款"——奴
隶本身相当于资产，并不是说奴隶主真的有大额银行账户。
D)
以偏概全
选项 Slavery was regarded as a peculiar institution 中 "was regarded" 给出一个被
动评价；原文 protections for the "peculiar institution" 把 "peculiar institution" 加
引号——这是南方人为奴隶制起的婉称，并非全社会普遍把奴隶制看作"特殊制度"。
华盛顿释放奴隶的决定源于他的____
A) 道德考虑。
B) 军事经历。
C) 财务状况。
D) 政治立场。

40. Washington's decision to free slaves originated from his____

【拆句】Q40 是不完整陈述句，Washington's decision to free slaves originated from his____，

【定位】Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal after observing the
bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War, overcame the strong opposition
of his relatives to grant his slaves their freedom in his will.
华盛顿在独立战争中目睹黑人士兵的英勇之后，已开始相信人人生而平等；他顶住亲属们强
烈的反对，最终在遗嘱中赋予自己的奴隶以自由。
【选项】A)
答非所问
选项 moral considerations 看似与 believe that all men were created equal 相关，
但"相信人人平等"是华盛顿在"目睹勇敢"之后才形成的信念，是中间结果，不是起源；题
问 originated from（起源）必须追到最上游的因，即军事经历。
B)
✓ 正确
after observing the bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War ↔
military experience
预判"源于独立战争中的观察"与 military experience 在语义上完全重合（战争中的观察
就是军事经历的一部分），锁定 B。
C)
无中生有
选项 financial conditions 在原文找不到任何对应：P6 只说华盛顿顶住亲属反对、在遗
嘱中释奴，并未涉及任何经济或财务原因；like having a large bank account 谈的
是"奴隶价值"而非释放奴隶的动机。
D)
无中生有
选项 political stand 在文中找不到关于华盛顿"政治立场推动释奴"的描述；
Washington and Jefferson privately expressed distaste for slavery 只说"私下
反感"，P5 的政治线讨论的是国父在政治上依赖奴隶制，与"政治立场推动释奴"方向
相反。

paras.en: Remember that your initial draft is only that. You should go through the paper many times – and then again – working to substantiate and clarify your ideas. You may even end up with several entire versions of the paper. Rewrite. The sentences within each paragraph should be related to a single topic. Transitions should connect one paragraph to the next so that there are no abrupt or confusing shifts. Awkward or wordy phrasing or unclear sentences and paragraphs should be mercilessly poked and prodded into shape.

He points out that he always experienced much difficulty in expressing himself clearly and concisely, but He disclaimed the possession of any great quickness of apprehension or wit, such as distinguished Huxley. His memory, too, he described as extensive, but hazy. So poor in one sense was it that he never could remember for more than a few days a single date or a line of poetry. This, he thought, could not be true, because the "Origin of Species" is one long argument from the beginning to the end, and has convinced many able men. partC.analysis:
逐句解析
句前 (N) 即考卷划线句题号，与卷面下划线句一一对应——满分 10 分、每句约 2 分，阅卷把每句切成意群按采
分点给分（★ 为采分点意群）。
【来源】一篇关于达尔文的学术评论 Charles Darwin∶His Place in Modern Science（查尔斯·达尔
文在现代科学中的地位），介绍了达尔文对自身智力水平和心智变化的评述，本文语篇结构
整体性强，考生只有在了解整个语篇的情况下才能正确、准确地翻译文中画线部分。
【主旨】达尔文在自传里以极谦逊的态度自评智力短长
全文是达尔文自传里的一段自我剖析：他承认自己表达不易、抽象推理与记忆都有限，但坚持认为
自己仍具备相当的推理与观察能力；末段又惋惜晚年对诗、画、音乐的趣味丧失。整体基调是「自
谦但据理力争」，翻译时所有评价性词语（如 modesty、humbly、limited、very limited、
disclaim、submit、injurious）都要落在「自我评估」这一语境里，不能译成第三方贬抑。开篇即
定调：Darwin himself speaks of his intellectual powers with extraordinary modesty.
(50)Darwin was convinced that the loss of these
tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more
probably to the moral character.

【指代】this very difficulty 回指「表达困难」
第 46 句开头的 this very difficulty 必须回到上一句锚定：he always experienced much
difficulty in expressing himself clearly and concisely。译时应明确还原为「（清楚简洁地）表
达自己的这种困难」或「这种表达上的困难」，不能含糊地译成「这个困难」。
these tastes 回指诗\、画\、音乐三类趣味
第 50 句的 the loss of these tastes，these tastes 回指紧邻上文：poetry of many kinds gave
him great pleasure. Formerly, too, pictures had given him considerable, and music very
great, delight. 翻译时应明确还原为「对诗歌、绘画和音乐的（这些）爱好/趣味」，不能笼统译成
「这些品味」。
the charge 回指「他只会观察、不会推理」的指控
第 48 句 the charge made by some of his critics 的具体内容由其后的 that 同位语给出：while
he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning。翻译 charge 时取「指责/指控/批
评」义，而非「费用、电荷」。
全篇主语「他」统一指达尔文
全文一连串 he/his 指的都是同一人——达尔文本人，见开篇：Darwin himself speaks of his
intellectual powers。逐句翻译时为避免人称悬空，可在必要处把「他」回填为「达尔文」，让中
文读者一眼看清主语归属。

(46) he believes that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage of forcing him
to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in
reasoning and in his own observations.
【意群】he believes that（主句主谓 + that 宾语从句引导词）→他认为
this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage（宾语从句主干（主 + 谓 + 宾））
★采分→这种困难本身可能反而带来了补偿性的好处
难点：very 作形容词\、compensating 取「补偿」义
this very difficulty 中的 very 不是副词「非常」，而是形容词「正是这个、恰恰这个」，译为
「正是这种困难/这种困难本身」；compensating advantage 字面是「补偿性的优势」，结合
语境是「弥补缺陷反带来的好处」。回填指代：this very difficulty 指上一句的 he always
experienced much difficulty in expressing himself clearly and concisely，故可译作「这种
（表达上的）困难本身」。
of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence,（of 引导的介词短语作 advantage
的同位/内容说明）★采分→（即）迫使他对每个句子都进行长时间而专注的思考
难点：of + doing 翻成「即……」
advantage of doing 的 of 在汉语里没有对应介词，应转译成「即/那就是」或干脆把 of 后内容
直接铺开作 advantage 的内容。intently 译「专注地、聚精会神地」，不要漏译副词。
and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations.（and 并列的现
在分词短语，承接前一个 of 短语）★采分→并因此使他得以察觉推理中和自己观察中的错误
难点：thus 表结果\、in reasoning / in his own observations 是并列介词短语
thus = 因此/从而，提示前后是「因→果」关系，必须译出来。enable sb. to do 译「使（某
人）能够……」。in reasoning 和 in his own observations 是 errors 后并列的两个介词短语，
都修饰 errors，要译成「推理中的错误和自己观察中的错误」，不能合并漏掉其中一项。
【调序】of 短语前置说明\、and 分句承接
英文用 advantage of doing… 这种「中心词+of+动名词」结构，中文不习惯说「迫使他……的好
处」，故改为「好处，即/那就是迫使他……」，把 of 短语后置展开；末尾 and thus enabling…
用「并因此使他能……」承接，让两层结果自然推进。
【译文】他认为，正是这种（表达上的）困难，或许反而给他带来了一种弥补性的好处，即迫
使他对每一个句子都进行长时间而专注的思考，从而使他能够察觉自己在推理中和观
察中所犯的错误。

(47) He asserted, also, that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was
very limited, for which reason he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics.
【意群】He asserted, also, that（主句主谓 + 插入副词 + that 引导宾语从句）→他还断言/他也声称
难点：also 是插入语「也」
also 被逗号隔开作插入语，承接上文「他不承认自己有 Huxley 那种敏捷领悟力」，译为「他
还/也」，放在动词前。assert 取「断言、声称、坚称」义，不要弱化为「说」。
his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited,（宾语从句主干
（主语带不定式定语 + 系 + 表））★采分→他追随一长串纯粹抽象思路的能力非常有限
难点：follow 取「跟上\、理解」义；train of thought 是「思路」
follow 在此不是「跟随」，而是「跟上/理解（一条思路）」（熟词僻义 A2）。a train of
thought 是固定搭配「一系列思路、一长串思考」，不能字面译成「思想的火车」。a long and
purely abstract train of thought = 「一长串纯粹抽象的思路」。very limited 译「非常有
限」，不可省「非常」。
for which reason（非限制性定语从句的关系词（= and for that reason））→因此/由于这个原因
难点：for which reason = 因此
for which reason 是 and for that reason 的非限定式写法，整体相当于一个连词「因此、出于
这个原因」，承接前一分句。中文断开成「正因为如此」「因此」更自然。
he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics.（定语从句主干（主 + 系 +
表 + that 宾语从句））★采分→他确信自己从来不可能在数学上获得成功
难点：could have done 表「与过去事实相反」
never could have succeeded 是虚拟语气的过去式（could have + 过去分词），表示「（过
去）本来也不可能成功」。succeed with mathematics 译「在数学上取得成功/搞好数学」。
felt certain that = 确信、深信。
【调序】his power to do → 「他做……的能力」前置；for which reason → 独立成句
英语 his power to follow… 中 to follow… 是后置不定式作定语，汉语习惯前置：译为「他追随一
长串纯粹抽象思路的能力」；for which reason 引导的定语从句太长，直接断成新一句「正因为如
此/因此，他确信……」更顺。
【译文】他还断言，自己跟上一长串纯粹抽象思路的能力非常有限，正因为如此，他确信自己
在数学上本来也绝不可能取得成功。

(48) On the other hand, he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of his critics
that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning.
【意群】On the other hand,（句首过渡状语）→另一方面
he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of his critics（主句主干
（accept...as... 结构，宾语后置）+ 过去分词短语作 charge 的定语）★采分→他并不认为某些批评者
对他提出的指责是有充分根据的
难点：accept A as B 宾语后置；well founded 译「有根据的」；charge 取「指责」义
本句的真正结构是 accept [the charge…] as [well founded]，因为宾语 the charge made
by… that… 太长，被挪到了 as well founded 之后（即 accept as B A 的倒装）。well
founded = well-founded，「有充分根据的、站得住脚的」。charge 在此是熟词僻义 A2：不
是「费用、电荷」，而是「指责、控告」（made by some of his critics 明确了语境）。整体译
「他不认为这些批评者的指责是有根据的」。
that,（that 引导同位语从句，说明 charge 的具体内容）→（即）
while he was a good observer,（让步状语从句）★采分→尽管他是个善于观察的人/优秀的观
察者
难点：while 译「虽然/尽管」
while 在此不是「当……的时候」，而是表让步「虽然、尽管」（A2 熟词僻义），与后半句构成
转折。a good observer 译「优秀的观察者/善于观察的人」。
he had no power of reasoning.（同位语从句主句）★采分→他却没有推理能力
难点：no power of reasoning 译「没有推理能力」
power of reasoning = 推理能力/推理的能力。结合让步从句，整句指控为「虽然他是好的观察
者，但没有推理能力」。这正是达尔文要反驳的对象。
【调序】宾语前移；让步从句前置；同位语用「即」展开
中文不接受 accept as well founded the charge 这种「宾语后置」，必须把 the charge 提到
accept 之后：「他不接受……的指责是有根据的」。同位语 that … 用「即/这种指责认为」展开。
while 让步从句按汉语习惯放在主句前：「尽管他是好的观察者，但他没有推理能力」。
【译文】另一方面，对于某些批评者对他提出的「他虽然善于观察，却没有推理能力」的指
责，他并不认为是有充分根据的。

(49) He adds humbly that perhaps he was "superior to the common run of men in noticing things
which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully."
【意群】He adds humbly that（主句主谓 + 方式状语 + that 引导宾语从句）→他谦逊地补充说
难点：humbly 译「谦逊地」，呼应全文基调
humbly 是副词「谦卑地、谦逊地」，呼应开篇 Darwin himself speaks of his intellectual
powers with extraordinary modesty. 的基调。adds 不要译成「加上」，此处是「补充说、
又说」。
perhaps he was "superior to the common run of men（宾语从句主干 + 表语（superior to…））★
采分→也许他「胜过/优于普通人」
难点：the common run of men 是固定短语「普通人/一般人」
the common run of 是固定搭配，译「普通的、一般的、平庸的」，the common run of men
= 普通人、一般人。superior to = 优于、胜过、强过。perhaps 不能漏，体现自谦的不确定语
气。注意此处仍在引号内，是达尔文原话。
in noticing things which easily escape attention,（in + 动名词作 superior to 的范围状语 + which
定语从句修饰 things）★采分→（在）注意到那些容易被人忽视的事物（方面）
难点：escape attention 译「逃过注意/被忽略」；which 定从前置
escape attention = 逃过注意、不为人察觉、被忽略。things which easily escape attention
字面是「容易逃过注意的事物」，按汉语习惯改前置定语「（那些）容易被人忽略的事物」。in
doing 表示「在某方面」，是 superior to sb. in doing 的固定搭配。
and in observing them carefully."（and 并列第二个 in + 动名词短语 + 副词）★采分→（在）仔细
观察它们（方面）
难点：them 回指 things；carefully 译「仔细地」
them 指上一块的 things（容易被忽略的事物），翻译时可不必重复名词，但要让中文读者明确
指向。carefully 不要漏，与前句 noticing 的「注意」形成「注意到 → 仔细观察」的递进。整
段引号在此结束，照应达尔文自评。
【调序】短定语从句前置\、in doing 并列承接
which easily escape attention 较短，前置译成「容易被忽略的（事物）」；两个 in doing 用
「在……方面 + 也在……方面」并列承接，或干脆并成「在注意到……并仔细观察它们方面」。
humbly 副词前置紧贴动词「谦逊地补充说」。
【译文】他谦逊地补充说，他或许「在注意到那些容易被人忽略的事物、并加以仔细观察方
面，胜过常人」。

(50) Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might
possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to the moral character.
【意群】Darwin was convinced that（主句主谓 + that 引导宾语从句）→达尔文确信
难点：be convinced that 译「确信、深信」
be convinced that = 确信、深信，比 think 语气重得多，必须译出来。
the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness,（宾语从句主干（not only … but …）的前
半）★采分→丧失这些爱好不仅是丧失了一种幸福
难点：these tastes 回指诗\、画\、音乐三种爱好；taste 取「爱好/兴趣」义
these tastes 必须回填指代：见上文 poetry of many kinds gave him great pleasure.
Formerly, too, pictures had given him considerable, and music very great, delight.，指诗
歌、绘画、音乐三种爱好/趣味。taste 在此是「爱好、欣赏力、趣味」（A2 熟词僻义），不是
「味道」。the loss of these tastes 译「丧失这些爱好/失去这些趣味」。a loss of happiness
= 一种幸福的丧失/失去一种幸福。
but might possibly be injurious to the intellect,（not only … but … 的后半，第一并列）★采分→
而且可能对智力有害
难点：injurious to 译「对……有害」；might possibly 体现谨慎语气
injurious to = 对……有害的，与下一块 to the moral character 共享 injurious。might
possibly 双重不确定，是达尔文一贯的谨慎语气，译「可能、有可能」即可，不要漏。the
intellect 译「智力/智识」。
and more probably to the moral character.（and 并列第二个介词短语，共享 injurious）★采分→
而且更可能对道德品格有害
难点：省略还原：(injurious) to the moral character；more probably 体现程度递进
本块省略了重复的 be injurious：完整意思是 and (might) more probably (be injurious) to
the moral character。more probably 与前文 might possibly 形成程度递进：「可能对智力
有害——更可能对道德品格有害」，必须把递进译出。the moral character = 道德品格/道德
人格。
【调序】not only…but… 顺译；省略 injurious 补出
not only A but (also) B 在汉语里直接对应「不仅 A 而且 B」，可顺译。and 并列的 more
probably to the moral character 要补出共享的 injurious，译为「而且更可能对道德品格（有
害）」。这样补一下，中文才完整。
【译文】达尔文确信，丧失这些（对诗歌、绘画、音乐的）爱好不仅是一种幸福的丧失，而且
可能对智力有害，更有可能对道德品格有害。

He points out that he always experienced much difficulty in expressing himself
clearly and concisely, but he believes that this very difficulty may have had the
compensating advantage of forcing him to think long and intently about every
sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own

第1段，第2句
这句在结构和时态上都很有训练意义：主干不至于难到无法入手，但又包含两个高频内容从句和一
个值得单练的情态完成结构。作为句子结构加时态的综合练习材料，优先级较高。
He disclaimed the possession of any great quickness of apprehension or wit, such
as distinguished Huxley.
第1段，第3句
本句覆盖了主谓宾基本结构,宾语中包含介词短语作后置定语,还有非限制性定语从句对名词进行补
充说明。成分种类较为丰富,特别是 "such as" 引导的定语从句结构具有一定辨识训练价值,适合练习
识别修饰关系和从句功能。
So poor in one sense was it that he never could remember for more than a few
days a single date or a line of poetry.
第1段，第6句
主句采用了完全倒装结构，表语前置、系动词提前、主语后置，打乱了正常的主谓表语序，初学者
需要先识别倒装再还原语序才能找到主干；同时状语从句嵌套在主句中，主语 "it" 被倒装和从句双
重遮挡，定位难度较高。
On the other hand, he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of
his critics that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning.
第1段，第7句
同位语从句解释抽象名词、状语从句嵌套在名词性从句中、定语后置修饰核心名词,这些都是四六
级和考研阅读中的高频句式,掌握后可大量迁移到同类长难句

This, he thought, could not be true, because the "Origin of Species" is one long
argument from the beginning to the end, and has convinced many able men.
第1段，第8句
主句+原因状语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式；插入语、并列谓语、情态动词与完成时的
搭配也是常考结构，学生掌握本句后可迁移应用到大量类似真题句，典型性很强。
No one, he submits, could have written it without possessing some power of
reasoning.
第1段，第9句
本句包含插入语、情态完成式谓语、介词短语状语、动名词作介词宾语等多种成分,且插入语的识
别和跨越是常见易错点。作为成分划分练习句,可以训练学生识别插入语、定位被分隔的主谓、区
分谓语与非谓语动词形式,训练价值较高
Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of
happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to
the moral character.
第2段，第5句
主句 "sb was convinced that..." 是四六级和考研阅读中高频出现的被动语态 + 宾语从句结构。从句
中 "not only... but (also)..." 并列结构和情态动词表推测也是常考句式。本句结构具有很强的代表
性，掌握后可迁移到大量类似长句中。

考研真题(2008)
Directions:
You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage that you forgot to return
to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to
1)make an apology, and
2)suggest a solution.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
【参考范文 · 108 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Dear Bob, I am writing to express my sincere apology for forgetting to return the music CD I borrowed from
you. After coming back from Canada, I was surprised to find it still lying in my luggage. I truly feel sorry for
any inconvenience this may have caused you.
To put things right, I would like to suggest a solution. I will post the CD back to you by international express
mail this weekend, so that it can reach you as soon as possible. Please let me know your current address.
Once again, I apologize for my carelessness and look forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
【参考译文】
亲爱的Bob： 我写这封信是为了就忘记归还向你借的那张音乐CD向你真诚致歉。从加拿大回国后，我惊
讶地发现它还躺在我的行李箱里。对于这可能给你带来的任何不便，我深感抱歉。 为了弥补，我想提出一
个解决办法。我会在本周末用国际快递把CD寄还给你，好让它尽快到你手中。请把你目前的收件地址告
诉我。 再次为我的粗心致歉，并期待你的回复。 此致 Li Ming
【第 1 段】事由＋致歉一体。本段用『亮明写信目的』句架开篇（I am writing to express my sincere
apology for forgetting to return the music CD），先把致歉意图前置；再用 After coming back
from Canada, I was surprised to find it still lying in my luggage 交代情境，让道歉有落点；末句 I
truly feel sorry for any inconvenience 补致歉，落实了第一段『称呼＋事由＋致歉』的功能。

【第 2 段】方案落到可执行。本段用『引出方案』句架 To put things right, I would like to suggest a
solution 起手，再用 I will post the CD back to you by international express mail this weekend, so
that ... 把办法写到谁做、怎么做、多久到达，最后 Please let me know your current address 征询对
方，方案具体可执行，达成第二段功能。
【第 3 段】呼应致歉＋合规落款。本段用 Once again, I apologize for my carelessness and look
forward to your reply 首尾呼应地收束歉意，再以 Yours sincerely 结尾、署名 Li Ming，既不签真名也
不写地址，正好卡住落款的硬约束。
A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些
是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。
核心任务
为忘还CD致歉并提办法
本题要写的核心交际任务被 Directions 用编号钉死成两件事：make an apology 和 suggest a
solution。触发情境是 You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your
luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there。所以一句话锁死：给房东 Bob
写信，为回国后行李里发现忘还的音乐CD真诚道歉，并提出一个具体可行的归还办法。两件事
缺一不可。
读者 · 语域
写给房东Bob的礼貌书信
读者是 your landlord there——你在加拿大的房东 Bob，是相熟但需要维护关系、表达歉意的
对象，所以语域取『礼貌得体的半正式书信』：称呼直接 Dear Bob（熟人用名不用姓氏加先
生），语气诚恳，多用歉意与建议的软化句式，既不端着也不油腔。身份是欠了人情、主动认
错的一方，因此姿态要放低。

中心立意
诚恳认错并给出可行归还方案
本信的交际目的：向 Bob 诚恳承认自己 forgot to return to Bob 那张CD的疏忽，把歉意传达到
位，同时给出一个他能接受、你能落实的归还方案，从而消除误会、维护你和房东的关系。中
心不是单纯说 sorry，而是『认错＋补救』一体。
要展开的要点
1. 交代事由
先讲清来龙去脉：刚从加拿大回国，整理行李时发现那张忘了还的音乐CD还在箱子里。对应情
境 You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage that you
forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there，交代清楚道歉才有落点。
2. 真诚道歉
落实第一个必写任务 make an apology：为自己的疏忽向 Bob 表达真诚歉意，并提及给对方带
来的不便，姿态要低、态度要诚。
3. 提出具体办法
落实第二个必写任务 suggest a solution：给出一个具体可执行的归还方案，如本周末用国际快
递把CD寄回，并请对方告知收件地址，必要时可补一句『若你更愿意，我也可以赔一张新的』
作备选。切忌只说『我会想办法还给你』这种空话。
S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段
怎么分段、每段写什么、能套哪些句架
按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的 功能
句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。
第 1 段
称呼＋事由＋致歉
以 Dear Bob 开头，说明写信缘由（回国后行李里发现忘还的CD），随即真诚道歉，落
实 make an apology。
第 2 段
提出解决方案
承接歉意，给出具体归还办法并征询对方，落实 suggest a solution。

第 3 段
礼貌收尾＋落款
再次致歉、表达期待回复，以 Yours sincerely 结束并署名 Li Ming，落实 Do not sign
your own name at the end of the letter 的要求。
第 1 段
回国发现忘还CD并致歉
本段内容落点：写明刚从加拿大回国、整理 You have just come back from Canada and found
a music CD in your luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there 这一事由，
然后为自己的粗心真诚道歉，并提及可能给 Bob 带来的不便。
亮明写信目的
· I am writing to express my sincere apology for ...（横线处填『忘了归还
向你借的音乐CD』这一事由）
交代情境
· After ..., I was surprised to find ...（前一空填时间/动作，后一空填发现的东
西，把『怎么发现的』讲清）
补充致歉
· I truly feel sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused you.（可整句
套用，表达为不便致歉）
第 2 段
国际快递寄回并征询地址
本段内容落点：给出具体办法——本周末用国际快递把CD寄回，让它尽快到达 Bob 手中，并
请对方告知当前收件地址；可再留一句备选（若对方更愿意，可赔一张新的），把 suggest a
solution 做实。
引出方案
· To put things right, I would like to suggest a solution.（可整句套用，自然
引出解决办法）
说明具体做法
· I will ... by ..., so that ...（第一空填动作如寄回CD，第二空填方式如国际
快递，第三空填效果如尽快送达）
征询对方
· Please let me know ... / Would it be all right if ...?（横线处填需要对方确认
的信息，如收件地址）

第 3 段
再次致歉并规范署名
本段内容落点：为疏忽再次道歉、表达盼复之意，然后按 Do not sign your own name at
the end of the letter 的要求，以 Yours sincerely 结尾并署名 Li Ming，且遵守 Do not write
the address。
再次致歉
· Once again, I apologize for ... and look forward to your reply.（横线处填致
歉对象如自己的粗心）
书信落款
· Yours sincerely,（换行）(指定署名)——本题此处只能写 Li Ming
R E V I E W · 自检避坑
本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标、容易在哪丢分
按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容
易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。
内容切题
两任务点都要写到
本题必须同时命中 make an apology 与 suggest a solution，缺任何一个都算内容不
完整；只道歉不给办法、或只给办法不道歉，都是本题最常见的切题失分。
结构连贯
两任务分段并衔接
本题把致歉和方案分成两段、再用过渡语连接，阅卷人一眼数得到两个要点；若把两
件事挤成一坨或通篇一段，连贯分就会掉。
语言准确
得体软化句式
本题是欠人情的一方，语气要软：用 sincere apology、I would like to suggest、
Please let me know 等得体表达，避免中式直译和光秃秃的祈使句。
字数格式
署名合规不写地址
本题要求 You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2，且必须以 Li
Ming 落款、遵守 Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter 与 Do not
write the address；这三条格式硬约束错一条就白丢分。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法
只道歉不给办法
反面示例：整封信写成『I am very sorry. I am really sorry for the CD. Thank you.』——反复道歉却
没提怎么还，直接漏掉 suggest a solution。修正：补写具体方案，如 I will mail the CD back to you
this weekend by express, and please tell me your address.
签真名或写地址
反面示例：结尾签了『Yours, Wang Lei』并在下面附上一行家庭住址——既违反 Do not sign your
own name at the end of the letter 又违反 Do not write the address。修正：结尾只写 Yours
sincerely, 换行 Li Ming，不加任何地址。
方案空泛无细节
反面示例：I will find a way to return it to you soon.——没说怎么还、什么时候还，等于没给方
案。修正：I will send the CD back to you by international express mail this Saturday, so that it
arrives quickly.
逐字直译不成句
反面示例：I very sorry to you for the CD thing, I will think how to give you.——缺 be 动词、搭配
错乱、意思含糊。修正：I am terribly sorry for forgetting to return your CD, and I will send it back
to you soon.

考研真题(2008)
Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1）describe the drawing briefly,
2）explain its intended meaning, and then 3）give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)

【参考范文 · 190 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, two disabled men, one having lost his left leg and the other his right, tie
their remaining legs together, throw away their crutches, and run swiftly in the same direction while supporting
each other. Below the picture, a line of words reads: 'You have one leg, I have one leg; together, we can
travel everywhere.'
Simple as it appears, the drawing conveys a thought-provoking message about the power of cooperation.
Neither man could walk far on his own, yet by binding their weaknesses together they turn two disabilities into
one working pair of legs. This symbolizes that when people pool their strengths and make up for one another's
shortcomings, they can overcome obstacles that no individual could conquer alone.
